SQLAlchemy pool size 50 caused staging contention; legacy invoice rounding edits were unrelated.

- [pending] Inspect and correct scheduler paid-customer filtering.
- [pending] Run focused tests, then continue one-by-one `rename_get_user_record` renames; verify references, commit/tag, and push.
Next: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`
